scope: Proposition 6.2 (Uniqueness from a nonzero candidate) of the manuscript “Irrational cubic fourfolds with geometric K3 categories” (preprints/Irrational-cubic-fourfolds-with-geometric-K3-categories-September-24-2026/Irrational-cubic-fourfolds-with-geometric-K3-categories-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 054 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f870a96114f1ac8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For d above the uniform bound fixed after (6.4), if an eligible k ⊂ L has σk(L, α) ̸= 0, then every eligible surface subfield of (L, α) equals k as an embedded subfield of L.
